period_note: Year-end position for Social Islami Bank PLC, Solo/Standalone basis (reporting_basis determined by matching this dataset's stored figures against the bank's own Solo-labeled Balance Sheet / 'Only Bank-Solo Basis' Highlights annexure / Note 16.5 'Capital Adequacy (Solo Basis)', as distinct from the parallel Consolidated Balance Sheet covering SIBL and its two wholly-owned subsidiaries, SIBL Securities Limited and SIBL Investment Limited). Shariah-based Islamic bank: 'Investments (General)' is the Shariah-compliant equivalent of conventional Loans and Advances, and 'Classified Investments' / 'Ratio of Classified Investments to Total Investments' is the equivalent of NPL / NPL ratio -- mapped to this dataset's gross_loans and npl_pct fields for cross-bank comparability, consistent with the convention already used for EXIMBANK, FIRSTSBANK and GIB in this dataset. Source: Annexure 'Highlights of Performance (Only Bank-Solo Basis)' (own report) lines ~20860-20905; own Directors' Report Capital Base comparative table lines ~5300-5375; '5 Years Key Financial Data' table in FY2024 report lines ~6640-6680.

Tier-I Capital (Core Capital / Going Concern Capital)
Tier-II Capital (Supplementary Capital / Gone Concern Capital)
Total Capital (Tier I + Tier II) / Capital Base

line_items.metric_note: Calculated as Total Capital / CRAR (both independently reported); not itemized as a standalone RWA figure in this year's own source tables.

line_items.original_metric_name: Capital to Risk Weighted Asset Ratio (CRAR)

line_items.metric_note: Calculated as Profit before Tax minus Profit after Tax (both independently reported); this year's own summary tables do not itemize the tax provision separately.

FY2023 report's own comparative column shows FY2022 PAT as 2,429,762,845 (vs this year's own 2,429,782,845) -- a ~20,000 Taka (0.0008%) digit-transposition-like divergence, well under the 0.05% flag threshold; the contemporaneous FY2022 figure is used per project convention.
